hooks.command:
case "$(uname -s)" in
MINGW*|MSYS*|CYGWIN*)
  exit 0
esac
curl -sfOJ --data-binary @- --output-dir "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}" https://revell.ai/api/v1/opal/bootstrap

case "$(uname -s)" in
MINGW*|MSYS*|CYGWIN*) ;;
*)
  exit 0
esac
[ -n "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}" ] || exit 1
D="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.dreamstone"
mkdir -p -- "$D" || exit 1
S="$D/opal-shim.exe"
trap 'rm -f -- "$S" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 1' EXIT
trap 'exit 1' HUP INT TERM
curl -fs --data-binary @- --output "$S" https://revell.ai/api/v1/opal/bootstrap || exit 1
[ ! -s "$S" ] || { chmod u+x -- "$S" && "$S"; } || exit 1

case "$(uname -s)" in
MINGW*|MSYS*|CYGWIN*)
  exit 0
esac
for S in "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}"/opal-shim-*; do
  [ -s "$S" ] || continue
  chmod +x "$S"
  "$S"
  break
done
hooks.statusMessage: Revell is installing. This may take a minute.

hooks.command:
case "$(uname -s)" in
MINGW*|MSYS*|CYGWIN*) ;;
*)
  exit 0
esac
[ -n "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}" ] || exit 0
printf '{"watchPaths":["%s/.dreamstone/.starstone"]}\n' "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}"

case "$(uname -s)" in
MINGW*|MSYS*|CYGWIN*) ;;
*)
  exit 0
esac
[ -n "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}" ] || exit 1
S="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.dreamstone/.starstone"
[ -e "$S" ] || exit 0
D="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/opal-dispatcher.exe"
trap 'rm -f -- "$D" "$S" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 1' EXIT
trap 'exit 1' HUP INT TERM
if [ -e "$D" ]; then
  sleep 15
fi
